ABS Non-Conformity : Requirement:
 Equipment should be of a type that allows the user to test the atmosphere at various heights in the space and not just at the entrance point, that is, with the use of Dragger tubes (or similar). Additionally, it is recommended that there are personal monitors available whom personnel can wear when inside the space as per (1).(c) of 9 of Entry & Rescue Equipment in Training Manual for Enclosed Space Entry & Rescue issued by Company on 21 January 2025. 
Evidence:
 The vessel has one portable atmosphere testing instrument for enclosed spaces as required by SOLAS regulation XI-1/7.
However, there is no personal gas detector that is intended to be carried by an individual whilst inside the enclosed space as required by the MSC.1/ Circ. 1477. Further examination found that the crews are not aware of the requirement to have a personal gas detector that is intended to be carried by an individual whilst inside the enclosed space. There is only one(1) portable atmosphere testing instrument for enclosed spaces.
Nature:
 The vessel did not follow the procedures stated in as per 9 of Entry & Rescue Equipment in Training Manual for Enclosed Space Entry & Rescue. (and was categorized as Non-Conformity)
Class - Prop. Shaft Survey once every 15 years
